dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible single thin line of high grayscale contrast across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, pale boundary edges along folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular triangular footprint of high contrast on the central nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Highly distinct and linear boundary between the dark crown and the greenish mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white auricular patch and yellow ventral plumage.
